target_corrections.fact: Receive loop rechecks object->socket on every iteration; cleanup runs after leaving the loop, including when the socket is initially null.
Four equality comparisons share the table-scan continuation; preserve BFME2's extra detail-string comparison.
Copy received packet+0x108 into entry+0x108, not entry data into packet+8. Store NetTick()+interval*2000+1000 directly into the deadline.
IPv4 words use socket-address bytes 4..7, not 0..3.
An occupied entry expires when address text is empty OR deadline is zero OR now exceeds its unsigned deadline.
Cancellation uses the candidate local and advances the link through *cursor; outgoing retransmission tests now > deadline and schedules interval*1000, not interval*2000.
Receive signature uses a separate three-copy gEA string at VA 0xDD9100. Do not bind it to the sender string at VA 0xDD90F4.

donor_differences_not_imported: Module offsets differ: BFME2 socket +0x38 versus Madden +0x28; table start +0x28 versus +0x14.
Madden uses bounded ds_strnzcpy and updates existing entry detail; BFME2 uses strcpy and compares detail when finding an entry.
Madden uses DirtyMemFree with a memory group; BFME2 calls the existing one-argument allocator free body.

linkage_repair.basis: The callback's call at +0x3E9 reaches the existing dotted IPv4 formatter. Its provider and existing caller now share C linkage with the callback. The old row is renamed and the redundant old pin removed; no duplicate body, alias pin or linker fallback is added.
